title: Clarified error when header value is None
body:
Previously, when the header value was None, a misleading error was thrown: "AttributeError: Object 'NoneType' does not have attribute 'encode'." Now it looks better.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ec12330f-aa7e-4084-8c81-c89aef8fdea9)
